frozen_metric: per-resolution label matched-purity (=1.0 exact reproduction), nesting_score, zoom_coherence_improvement_rate (fraction of coarse clusters whose child purity improves on zoom)
frozen_success_rule: reproduction matched-purity >= 0.95 at every resolution; nesting_score == 1.0; zoom_improvement_rate at N==1200 not materially below the accepted N==1000 baseline

mode_0.7.note: Some individual resolution-steps showed negative mean improvement (fine clusters less pure than coarse parents). zoom_improvement_rate_comparison.convention: per-transition-average of the fraction of coarse clusters (size>=3, branch known) whose mean-child-purity improves on zoom, averaged over the 6 resolution transitions; IDENTICAL computation for N=1000 and N=1200 side (recomputed in repair 33317520019).
zoom_improvement_rate_comparison.note: The accepted N=1000 values recorded in state (0.1944 for 0.5, 0.2759 for 0.7) use the CHILD-CLUSTER-LEVEL convention (total_improvements/total_evaluated) and are NOT numerically comparable to the per-transition-average convention used for N=1200. Comparing them directly (0.2759 vs 0.265) would make mode 0.7 look flat/declining, but that is a convention mismatch, not a real decline. The correct comparison uses one convention for both sides, as recomputed here: BOTH modes improved at N=1200.
